goal_text: Find the bug in this JavaScript function that creates counter closures. Identify the line number, bug category, and propose the exact fix.
ground_truth: Bug at line 3: 'var i' is function-scoped (not block-scoped). All closures capture the same 'i' by reference. After the loop finishes, i=5, so every counter() call returns 5 instead of 0,1,2,3,4. Category: logic error (var hoisting / closure capture semantics). Fix: replace 'var i' with 'let i', which creates a new binding per iteration.

rubric.check_text: Identifies line 3 (var i) as the bug
Categorizes as logic error / closure capture
